# OMP Session Gateway

> Native integration with stock Oh My Pi (OMP) >=18.1.20. No OMP fork, custom build,
> gateway-specific OMP plugin, or publisher credential. Stable v0.5.0 is published as immutable
> GitHub Latest. Keep using OMP in the terminal; the separate gateway discovers collaboration-enabled
> sessions and opens OMP's own encrypted View/Control client from an Android-first PWA. One-time
> setup requires collab.autoStart, Bun 1.4.0, gateway installation, and TUN-mode Tailscale Serve
> with Funnel disabled. No per-session QR scan or link copy. Community project; not affiliated
> with or endorsed by the Oh My Pi maintainers.

## Current qualification boundary

- Stable v0.5.0 (source 1750ab454be1517d615167343562304766abb99c) was promoted from signed candidate v0.5.0-prealpha.1 with identical runtime bytes. The candidate's six non-cleanup lanes passed on 2026-09-23; its original receipt remains failed at cleanup, which was corrected (#223) and exercised directly. No claim for arbitrary builds from main.
- Exact OMP v18.1.20 source: 1bd60c6fbd0e800a75fd09b1e4804af5a5e6d63b. Set only collab.autoStart (off/view/control); start participating sessions with plain omp. The gateway reads OMP discovery and queries each host; OMP does not register with the gateway.
- Debian 13 (trixie) x86-64, Linux 6.12.94+deb13-amd64: 83/83 migration/recovery invariants, stock OMP publication/revocation, persistence, tagged-identity denial/exposure, uninstall and resource teardown.
- Mac14,3 / macOS 26.6.1 arm64: doctor 18/18, rollback 23/23, install/rotation/reboot-to-login persistence, real allowlisted identity and forged-header/exposure checks. Positive allowed-user HTTPS was measured on Mac/Pixel, not the tagged Debian CI caller.
- Pixel 10 Pro / Android 17 build CP2A.260805.005 / Chrome 153.0.8010.52: View read-only, Control writable, prompt accepted, return to directory; same-page unlock 9,138 ms, Airplane 8,309 ms, Doze 8,356 ms; all seven forbidden capability sinks detectable and clean.
- Tailscale Serve over tailnet HTTPS only, TUN mode required, Funnel disabled. Fresh relay check: 1,800 seconds (2026-09-23T06:08:25.733Z–06:38:25.743Z), two transitions, final phase live. The founder renewed the 30-minute check in place of eight hours; eight-hour endurance was not rerun or claimed, no historical endurance transfers, and residual prolonged-operation risk is accepted. No bounded-memory-growth claim is made.
- Windows OMP, background Web Push, specialized attention and branch/resume, and new media qualification remain unqualified/unadvertised. Seeded-fixture product media is not release-qualification evidence for these lanes. Android radio changes can still wedge Chrome; the proven same-page recoveries do not remove that limit.
- v0.4.2 is the migration/rollback predecessor; it rejects busy-emitting OMP hosts. Gateway rollback does not switch OMP.
- In v0.5.0 and earlier, the first visit after a gateway upgrade can navigate a pending launch or an open View/Control page back to the directory: the service worker cannot see that a page is in use because Chromium reports each page's creation URL. The first post-release View/Control smoke failures match this navigation. The unreleased fix on main never navigates from the worker.
- Published-byte local/Pixel checks passed through bounded follow-up paths after the original smoke failed at View/Control; this is composed verification, not a clean first-attempt smoke.

## Fork-era release history

- v0.3.0 requires its exact patched OMP v18.1.14 and matching historical instructions. Its qualification does not transfer to the mainline architecture.
